title: Arthroplasty Assessment
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. The detector over collects on purpose: mark anything that is teaching rather than clinical direction as NOT_CLINICAL rather than deleting it.

positions.as_written: Confirm the source: the pain is at the knee, reproduced by loading the knee, and not reproduced by moving the hip or the spine.
Record the function in activities, with the walking distance, the stairs, the chair and the sleep.
Record the alignment standing in both planes, naming varus, valgus and fixed flexion separately.
Record the range, with the extension deficit stated first.
Record the correctability of the deformity and the state of both collateral ligaments.
Examine the skin for previous incisions, ulceration, cellulitis and venous change, since all affect the approach and the risk.
Record the neurovascular state, including the pulses and the sensation, as a baseline.
Examine the other knee and the hips, because the sequence of treatment depends on them.
